nodes.description: Public mapping (address => uint256) storing the token balance of every account; written by the constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Public string holding the token name 'CAC_2400_20200917'.
Public string holding the token symbol 'CACAVT'.
Public uint8 holding the number of decimals (18).
Public uint256 total token supply, minted entirely to the deployer in the constructor.
Public nested mapping (owner => spender => uint256) holding approved spending allowances.
Constructor-like public function that mints the whole totalSupply to msg.sender and emits a Transfer event from address(0).
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value): checks the caller balance with require, then debits the sender and credits the recipient.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value): writes the allowance granted by msg.sender to spender and emits Approval.
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): checks balance and allowance, moves tokens and decrements the allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender throughout the contract.
Arithmetic underflow sink: balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value inside transfer (unchecked uint256 subtraction).
Arithmetic overflow sink: balanceOf[to] += value inside transfer (unchecked uint256 addition).
Arithmetic underflow sink: balanceOf[from] -= value inside transferFrom (unchecked uint256 subtraction).
Arithmetic overflow sink: balanceOf[to] += value inside transferFrom (unchecked uint256 addition).
Arithmetic underflow sink: allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value inside transferFrom (unchecked uint256 subtraction).
User-supplied recipient address parameter 'to' of transfer.
User-supplied uint256 amount parameter 'value' of transfer.
User-supplied spender address parameter 'spender' of approve.
User-supplied uint256 allowance amount parameter 'value' of approve.
User-supplied source address parameter 'from' of transferFrom.
User-supplied recipient address parameter 'to' of transferFrom.
User-supplied uint256 amount parameter 'value' of transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the constructor to receive the minted totalSupply.
msg.sender is used in transfer as the debited balance owner.
msg.sender is used in approve as the allowance owner key.
msg.sender is used in transferFrom as the spending address for the allowance check.
msg.sender indexes the balance decremented in transfer's unchecked subtraction.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented by transferFrom.
Constructor reads totalSupply to credit the deployer balance.
Constructor writes the full totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
balanceOf is the storage read that is decremented by the value in transfer.
Caller-supplied value directly determines the subtraction amount in transfer.
balanceOf is the storage mapping credited in transfer.
Caller-supplied 'to' selects the balance slot that is increased in transfer.
Caller-supplied value directly determines the addition amount in transfer.
approve writes the allowance mapping for the caller/spender pair.
Caller-supplied spender is the second key written into allowance.
Caller-supplied value is stored as the approved allowance amount.
transferFrom reads the allowance mapping to validate the spend.
transferFrom writes back the reduced allowance mapping entry.
balanceOf[from] is read and then decremented in transferFrom.
Caller-supplied 'from' selects the balance slot decremented in transferFrom.
Caller-supplied value determines the subtraction amount in transferFrom.
balanceOf is the mapping credited in transferFrom.
Caller-supplied 'to' selects the balance slot increased in transferFrom.
Caller-supplied value determines the addition amount in transferFrom.
allowance[from][msg.sender] is the storage slot decremented in transferFrom.
Caller-supplied 'from' is the first key of the allowance entry being decremented.
Caller-supplied value determines the allowance subtraction amount.
transfer executes the sender balance decrement after the require check.
transfer executes the recipient credit immediately after the sender debit.
transferFrom executes the sender balance decrement after the balance/allowance require checks.
transferFrom credits the recipient immediately after debiting 'from'.
transferFrom decrements the allowance after moving the balances.
Constructor control flow ends by writing the initial balance entry.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter is only meaningful inside transfer and has no independent identity once the function is normalized.
The 'value' parameter is local to transfer and is fully captured by the function's unsafe subtraction/addition operations.
The 'spender' parameter exists only as an argument of approve and should be absorbed into that function node.
The 'value' parameter is a transient input of approve and collapses into the function node.
The 'from' parameter is only used within transferFrom and is subsumed by that function node.
The 'to' parameter is only used within transferFrom and is subsumed by that function node.
The 'value' parameter is a transient argument driving transferFrom's unsafe arithmetic and merges into the function node.
